_about: RUN TWO [the board's quests are people], 10/18/26: the settlement board's people, drawn from QUESTS' act-one designs (research only, rule 35: read, never asked to build). Baked by tools/bohemia_run2_board_shelf.py; picked by slices/bohemia_board_shelf.js for the settlement's board AND the phone's list, so the phone never shows a job the place does not. A modder edits this file: add a row, keep two sentences with {pay} in the second; {crew} is the party that raided the place.

counts.why: QUESTS QR-O: camp 1, town 2, fortress 3, raid leaves 1, never over 4 (the settlement's TIER_OFFERS)

refresh_why: QUESTS QR-O's draft, one board per base per 3 map days; TUNING owns it
pay_why: the board's rule since 10/5: Battle Brothers' contract line at ten crowns a battery, a skull 30; TUNING owns it

offers.design_title: THE WOLVES THAT FOLLOW THE WATER
offers.title: Run off the wolves at the water
offers.says: Seven of them, big as ponies, and they come when the water comes. We cannot pay what you are worth, only {pay} batteries, and if you say no it is fine, everybody says no.

offers.title: Bring back the light regulator

client.name: Yesi Ortega
client.from: who keeps the one window lit

offers.says: The regulator for our one window is at the pump station, and six scavs sleep on it. Bring it back so the camp has a light at night again, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Fetch the paint for the hall sign
offers.says: A place without a name is a place you leave, and my eleven tins of paint sit past the hyenas. Bring them and I name it after whoever you want, plus {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Get the water tower its valve
offers.says: The tower is full of air because the Canal boys have the valve. Buy it or take it, I am not asking which, and the camp pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Take back three solar panels
offers.says: Twelve panels, they broke nine, and the three good ones sit on their lookout. Three is the difference between a light and none, so bring them home for {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Bring the little bulbs from the church
offers.says: We want to get married under lights, and the church on Lamb has a box of the little bulbs. The people there do not talk, they just watch, so go careful, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.design_title: THE BELL BACK IN THE CHAPEL
offers.title: Buy back the chapel bell
offers.says: We sold the bell for beans and the dealer melts it in four days. I want to ring it once, so bring it back and the chapel pays {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: THE WATER CARTS TO THE WASH
offers.title: Walk the water carts to the wash
offers.says: Two carts go to the wash camp, and the drivers say something follows them. Bring the mules back, mules cost more than water, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.design_title: THE PACK THAT DRINKS AT JEAN
offers.title: Hunt the pack that drinks here
offers.says: They come every second night, and one of them is not a coyote. Read their prints before noon, the wind takes them, and I pay {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: THE FARM TOWER HOLDS ONE NIGHT
offers.title: Hold the farm tower one night
offers.says: They come in three nights, sixteen of them, maybe more, and the seed cannot run. Hold the ground floor till morning and the farm pays {pay} batteries, the roof is yours to use.

offers.title: Bring the pump from the nursery
offers.says: Food is the leg we do not have, and the pump we need sits in the nursery on Rainbow. The cattle there are wrong, big, not angry, just big, and the roof pays {pay} batteries for that pump.

offers.title: Find the stolen battery bank
offers.says: Somebody took my battery bank up to the parking structure, level three. Bring it back and you get {pay} batteries, and your driver's wheels are paid, both.

offers.design_title: THE BALLOT BOX FROM BLOCK SEVEN
offers.title: Carry the ballot box from block seven
offers.says: Block seven votes like everybody else, but the road washed out and their box is still over there. Bring it sealed before the count in three nights, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Sweep the sand off six panel rows

client.name: Ingrid Oyelaran
client.from: the shift lead at the field

offers.says: Six rows are under the sand, and people sleep in rows four and five. Two days, sand first, the rest you tell me, and the field pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Find the caravan four days late
offers.says: My drivers are four days late, and they are never late, not with medicine. Find them on the south road and you get {pay} batteries, the load we talk about after.

offers.title: Bring the Salcedo family home
offers.says: Five names, the Salcedos, at the cousin's farm since spring, and the vote is in ten days. Bring them or bring me why not, either is an answer, and the co-op pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Carry the sealed letter over the pass
offers.says: A sealed letter goes to the council over the pass, signed for and back here in six days. Do not read it, the seal is the receipt, and the tower pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Clear the dogs off the back wall
offers.says: Eleven dogs come over the back wall after dark, always the same wall. Some of them were ours, do it anyway, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Clear the crew off the intake deck
offers.says: Turbine dos is choking on half the desert, and a hungry crew is taking my steel off the intake deck. Get them off for three nights and the dam pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Haul two tankers of water
offers.says: Two tankers of water to our loading dock before sundown tomorrow. It pays {pay} batteries, we do not negotiate upward, we are already generous.

offers.title: Stand in the hole in the wall
offers.says: Two nights for the cement to set, and something comes through that hole every second night. Stand in it, that is the job, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Bring the cook's man home

client.name: Doña Remedios
client.from: who fed this place twenty years

offers.says: Twenty years I fed this place, and they took him for a debt that was mine. Bring him home and I light the stove, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Bring up the crates from Sunrise
offers.says: Nobody comes in because they do not believe there is anything here, and the basement at Sunrise has two crates. Something big lives down there, from the fossil lab, so it pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Bring six cells for the barber's pole
offers.says: No power, no fades, only scissors, and six cells sit in the white limo on Koval. Bring them and the pole spins again, plus {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Clear the dogs out of the wrecks
offers.says: Under all that trash is a good lot, and a lot of dogs live in the wrecks. Clear it, keep what you dig out, and {pay} batteries on top.

offers.design_title: THE TIGERS BEHIND THE SHOW DOOR
offers.title: Put down the show's two tigers
offers.says: Two white tigers were the show, and now they stay in back by the laundry. Do not shoot them in front of the guests, we have guests, and the house pays {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: THE RELIEF SHIFT TO THE DAM
offers.title: Walk the relief shift to the dam
offers.says: Four of mine walk to the dam for the shift change at dawn the day after tomorrow. You watch the road for {pay} batteries, because late is a man asleep on a rail.

offers.title: Fetch the pigment for the mural
offers.says: Thirty people died here and nobody can say all their names. The pigment is in the art store on Charleston, on sabre-tooth ground, and it pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Hold the wall the night they come back
offers.says: {crew} hit our store, and their tracks bend back toward this lot. Stand on the wall the night they come and the harvest pays {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: THE COUNTING ROOM THEY CAME BACK FOR
offers.title: Guard the counting room three nights
offers.says: {crew} took the count and two of my men, and they come back for the charge room the night the power is up. Three nights at the door, they leave with nothing and you leave with {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: TWO NIGHTS AT THE MOAPA WELL
offers.title: Sit two nights at the gate
offers.says: {crew} come every fourth night, for our batteries, not the water. Two nights here, you are here and they are not, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.design_title: THE ROOF WITH THE LONG VIEW
offers.title: Hit their fire in the dry wash
offers.says: Six of {crew} sit in the dry wash and light fires at night like they own it. I can see them from here right now, so go, and the block pays {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: THE FEVER CAMP BY THE WELL
offers.title: Move the fever camp off the well
offers.says: The caravan came with the fever, and they sleep ten metres from our only well. Move them up to the old school on the hill, gently, and the clinic pays {pay} batteries.

offers.design_title: THE FREEZER AT THE FOSSIL BEDS
offers.title: Bring the freezer from the fossil beds
offers.says: The lab at the fossil beds has a freezer on its own panels that never went warm. Bring me the freezer, empty it first if you have to, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.design_title: THE LODGE ABOVE THE SNOW LINE
offers.title: Bring medicine down from the lodge
offers.says: The lodge on the mountain kept a pharmacy, and nobody has been up since the snow. Bring antibiotics, anything in a sealed bottle, and the clinic pays {pay} batteries.

offers.title: Get the clinic's cold box back
offers.says: Somebody took my cold box with the insulin in it, mija. Bring it back and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Haul eighty tyres to the co-op
offers.says: Four hundred tyres came in for the fair and there is room for two hundred, and the co-op wants eighty. Haul them over, do not sell any on the way, and {pay} batteries are yours.

offers.title: Ride with three carts to Primm
offers.says: Three carts go to Primm for the fair, and you do not look under the tarps. Primm's market pays you {pay} batteries at the far end, I pay you to be strangers.

offers.title: Ride shotgun to the salt camp
offers.says: The salt goes out to the camp while the fair is buying. Ride shotgun with me there and back, and {pay} batteries are yours.
